goals: Keep constraint objects identical across the canonical file, state, and every checkpoint.
Bind f8e203b6 evidence to both frozen locks and the stable source/tree fingerprints.
Record the evidence commit through a non-self-referential subsequent receipt.

constraints.description: All 20 product-screen rows must record an observed primary-function pass and resolve to a scenario video from the final bundle.

validation.validation_method: Parse the matrix, count 20 result rows, and resolve all 29 bundle paths.

constraints.description: Approvals, Providers, Models, Agents, Tools, Knowledge, Memory, About, and Cost must assert the named interaction rather than route or search-result visibility alone.

validation.validation_method: Inspect the final BDD steps and replay the passed Cucumber scenarios.

constraints.description: Global, agent, and user memory scopes must be observed explicitly; exact assistant text, JWT, and same-tenant user isolation must have non-vacuous rejection controls without treating sibling structured artifacts as response text.

validation.validation_method: Inspect explicit MCP scope assertions and replay paired 200/401 plus same-tenant owner/denial assertions with required response status and body shapes.

constraints.description: The bundle must bind fresh processes to the tested Git SHA, both frozen pnpm lockfiles, immutable Git tree, and stable feature-source fingerprint with unique playable videos, a retained run transcript, and a report generated from the finalized manifest.

validation.validation_method: Validate the process transcript, manifest SHA/fingerprints, artifact hashes and bytes, video codec/duration, duplicate paths, finalized report, and tamper control.

constraints.description: The report must stay limited to the local Chromium server-full profile, state that canonical plan revision 7 followed the repairs, cite the immutable operator waiver, and pass strict OpenSpec validation.

validation.validation_method: Inspect profile, defect, chronology, and waiver text, then run strict OpenSpec and scoped diff checks.

stages: Correct the evidence-commit design to use a subsequent immutable receipt.
Replay bundle, matrix, OpenSpec, and all source integrity checks.
Validate full constraint-object equality in state and every checkpoint.
Persist and archive a new byte-identical active/history cycle.
Commit the evidence allowlist, then record that commit in a second receipt.
